reported_error: Unable to getDisplayMedia: Media projections require a foreground service of type ServiceInfo.FOREGROUND_SERVICE_TYPE_MEDIA_PROJECTION

implementation.manifest: The app manifest declares FOREGROUND_SERVICE and FOREGROUND_SERVICE_MEDIA_PROJECTION and assigns foregroundServiceType=mediaProjection to flutter_background IsolateHolderService.
implementation.ordering: Android requests screen-capture consent, initializes/enables FlutterBackground foreground execution, waits for ActivityManager to report IsolateHolderService as foreground, then creates the LiveKit screen-share track. A timeout aborts capture with a clear error and cleanup.
implementation.api_behavior: The release manifest merger resolves targetSdkVersion 36 and retains the mediaProjection service type and permission. flutter_background 1.3.1 returns from enableBackgroundExecution immediately after startForegroundService(), before its asynchronous onStartCommand/startForeground sequence completes; the app now waits for that transition.

checks.observation: Fresh release APK updated the existing signed install in place, preserving the authenticated session. Selected Android's whole-screen source and completed capture: MediaProjectionManager started, the app IsolateHolderService was foreground with type 0x00000020 (MEDIA_PROJECTION), and Android created a successful 1080×2400 virtual display. The app published its own screen-share track and rendered the full portrait screen in the viewer preview; no Unable to getDisplayMedia, TrackPublishException, or fatal app exception appeared in filtered logcat. The SHARE_TEST roster showed only the local participant, so receiver behavior was not tested. In-app stop returned the control to 'Начать демонстрацию экрана' and dumpsys media_projection had no active projection; leaving the room ended the voice lease. The drawer's direct voice entry enabled the default microphone before the dock rendered; it was muted as soon as the connected screen appeared. No other participant was present, and the app left the room after the test.

checks.name: Android OS-level stop and peer receiver verification
checks.observation: Started whole-display capture again with the microphone muted. Android confirmed TYPE_SCREEN_CAPTURE and RECORD_CONTENT_DISPLAY; IsolateHolderService was foreground with type 0x00000020 (MEDIA_PROJECTION). The app's foreground-service notification channel is disabled on this device (importance=NONE), and no BOOHTACORD stop notification was available in the notification shade. After opening and dismissing system Quick Settings, dumpsys media_projection became null, but the app still showed a black local preview and stale active-share UI until its in-app stop control was tapped. That control cleared the share UI; leaving the room returned the app to prejoin. Final checks showed no active projection and no active microphone AppOp. No second receiver was present, so peer rendering/metrics remain unverified.
checks.reason: System-stop behavior cannot be conclusively accepted while the app's foreground-service notification channel is disabled and no receiver is available. The capture ended at OS level but stale local sharing UI remained until manual app stop.
